summary: Restore payload visibility for Status stringification modes.
explanation: The failures share one mode-handling cause across the public API and heap-backed renderer. With a status containing payloads `foo=bar` and `bar=\xff`, `Status.ToString()` and the default-based ostream and `absl::StrCat(status)` paths produce only `INTERNAL: fail`, so the assertions expecting `[foo='bar']` and `[bar='\\xff']` fail. `Status.ToString(mode)` currently discards `mode` and always passes `kWithEverything`; then `StatusRep::ToString` checks whether the mode equals `kWithPayload`, so `kWithEverything` does not print payloads. Forward the caller’s mode and test the payload bit. This keeps `kWithNoExtraData` and `~kWithPayload` payload-free while enabling payloads for `kWithPayload` and `kWithEverything`.
